about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the files of the surface whatsapp join one workspace package @purin-labs/surface-whatsapp in surfaces/whatsapp. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder: a Worker file goes to server/ with its sub-path below services/platform/src/, less its first folder when that folder is whatsapp/ (the longer line of sourcePrefixes gives this rule, one time for each file, and no two files then share a place). sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from the Worker manifest. The exports map gives each .ts file of server/ as an entry. The tsconfig of the package reads server/ only. The Worker tsconfigs include surfaces/*/server (the preparation commit "Type checks: the Worker and the Portal programs read the surface packages and the Shopify folder"), so each file stays in the program that checked it before the move. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder or a source folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. The first surface package: the edits add the root folder surfaces to the source roots, the clone scan, knip and the IFC ESLint run. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. connector-whatsapp-rpc.ts imports actors/whatsapp-operator-notice.ts of the surface slack, which moves later: the import keeps a relative path until the slack move names it by its package. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own file server/webhook-route.ts reads the Env key CONNECTOR, which services/platform/src/actors/connector.ts (workers/platform) merges with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env. Through the foundation packages that it imports the program also lacks CASE, CODE_MODE_SANDBOX, EVENT_Q, MESSAGE_LINK_FETCH, ORGANISATION and SESSION. The package alone gives 141 errors, 2 of them in its own files. The Worker program checks each file of server/.

edits.why: the lints that walk the product source read the new root folder surfaces
the clone scan reads the new root folder surfaces

knip reads each surface package and judges each of its exports (includeEntryExports), as it judged them in the Worker and the Portal: a surface package is a module of the Worker and the Portal, not an entry for others
knip does not judge the exports of a fixture file or a declaration file of a surface package, as for an area package: the Worker and the Portal workspaces did not judge them
ESLint reads the new root folder surfaces in pnpm lint:ifc-boundaries
edits.replace: eslint services/platform/src foundation areas surfaces apps/portal/src

edits.why: the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the Worker files of the package
